fields.name: stale_708
fields.evidence: RAM residue: moved with the panel copy by Part_CopyToBuffer (0x520 B from +0x2e0) but written by no song-panel copy (BitMapOut_ComputeRegionDelta stops at +0x702); dozens of distinct byte values per offset over 153 slots

notes: A slot is the RAM image of SEQ_SONG_RECORD 0xf180..0xf97f (the current song) / SEQ_SONG_SLOTS 0xab000 + 0x800*n; offsets are slot-relative, RAM name = 0xf180 + offset. Most names come from the .equ table v10/maincpu/shared/ram_variables_by_use.s and from the constant-offset calls to the slot accessors Part_ReadByteDirect/Part_WriteByte/Part_ReadWord/Part_WriteWord (BC = offset). Defaults: Part_InitVoiceDefaults writes +0..+8, +0x14..+0x1b, +0x42..+0x4d, +0xbd; SeqInit_Return / SeqParams_InitDefaults the edit block. File side: 72 SQT files, 153 slots (9 files have 10 slots, +4 = 1; the rest 1). +5/+6 (01 08) are written 1 and 8 by Part_InitVoiceDefaults and tested by SeqLoad_CheckAutoAccompFlag (+6 < 3, +5 == 0): a format version 1.08 [INFERENCE]. +4: SeqSavePre sets slot 0's byte to 1 for the save, SeqSavePost back to 0. CORRECTION to notes/floppy-kn5000-2026-10-29/README.md ('every start field read 0xffff'): the +0xd0 track table does hold the first cell of each present track (132/132 chain heads, tails = +0x78, end marks at +0x98); the slot links track t to its chain. The empty template slots carry stale bytes at +0xd0 with bit 7 clear. Probes (committed in notes/floppy-kn5000-2026-10-29/probes/): sqt_slots.py <extracted dir> var LO HI (per-offset variety), sqt_tracks.py <dir> (track table / tail / free-list / used-size checks), partcalls.py and ramrefs.py (run from the worktree root: accessor offsets and RAM references), write_sqt_spec.py (this file + tiling check); the reader search of every field over v5..v10: notes/kn5000-style-2026-10-31/probes/sqt_field_refs.py. Extract the disks first with floppy/tools/fat12_extract.py.
